settings.heading:
Support is the core.
Comfort is the layer.
settings.lede: A back that hurts in the morning is usually a core that has stopped holding. Ours is twenty centimetres of seven-zone pocket springs, and the comfort above it is settled separately, after you have slept on it.

settings.heading:
Support and comfort
are not the same job.
settings.body_1: Most mattresses solve both with the same five centimetres, which is why fixing one makes the other worse. Softer for the shoulder means less under the hip. Firmer for the back means pressure at the shoulder.
settings.body_2: Ours separates them. The core holds. The layer adapts.
settings.pull: Ours separates them. The core holds. The layer adapts.

settings.heading: Seven zones along the bed
settings.body_1: Your hips are the heaviest part of you and they sink first. On a single-tension mattress that tips the spine out of line for eight hours, and you feel it at seven in the morning rather than at eleven at night.
settings.body_2: Heavier two millimetre wire sits under the hips and shoulders. One point eight everywhere else. Each spring in its own pocket, so one person turning over does not move the other.

settings.heading:
You do not have to
get it right.
settings.body_1: Which is fortunate, because nobody can. Firm or soft, medium or medium firm, it is an impossible question to answer before you have slept on it.
settings.body_2: So you do not answer it. Sleep on it, tell us where it is wrong, and we make a new comfort layer to that description. With our compliments, for a year.

settings.a1_body: A year to tell us how it should feel. We remake the comfort layer to that, with our compliments, as often as it takes.
settings.a2_body: Collected from your home and refunded in full. Emperor is made to order and excluded.
settings.a3_body: The part that carries you is guaranteed for a quarter of a century.

settings.heading: Choose your size
settings.lede: Every size is the same build. Thirty five centimetres, seven-zone core, removable comfort layer. You do not choose a firmness.
